# MÖBIUS

> Möbius is an open-source Agent Session Hub. Search, cite, resume and hand off context across Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Pi, Grok, and OMP without rewriting a harness.

Möbius is open-source desktop software by Tardis. It is not Microsoft Mobius, ControlTheory Möbius, or Circular Labs Mobius. Current preview: v0.3.19 for Windows, MIT licensed, $0. It does not sell model accounts. OpenClaw history is on the roadmap and is not indexed in this preview.

## What Möbius is

Möbius indexes approved local agent transcripts by project directory and worktree, including OpenCode's read-only `opencode.db`. Native resume stays with the original harness. Switching agents starts a new target session and carries confirmed Session references, not a generated summary.

## What Möbius is not

- It does not provide model accounts, subscriptions, or API credits.
- It does not rewrite Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, Pi, Grok, or OMP transcripts.
- It does not inject other sessions into context by default.
- It does not currently index OpenClaw / Clawdbot history.
- Local recall is FTS/BM25. Optional hybrid ranking uses localhost Ollama embeddings only after an explicit enable command, and fails open to lexical if the model is missing.

## Core workflows

1. Find sessions from the project and worktree, then inspect the exact source message.
2. Resume the original agent in an interactive PowerShell tab, or open a blank terminal.
3. Hand off a reviewable reference envelope to another agent in the same checkout.
4. Follow the project handoff graph back to confirmed ancestors.
5. Keep Markdown notes, a multimedia canvas, read-only folder mounts, and managed skills beside the workbench.

## Precise search vs full-text vs semantic

- Precise references: copy `@session:provider/id#mN` when the source is known.
- Full-text recall: Mome uses local SQLite FTS/BM25, returns at most three citable sessions, and caps output at about 1,200 tokens.
- Hybrid ranking: opt-in localhost embeddings; missing models keep lexical recall.

## Supported harnesses

Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, Pi, Grok, and OMP. Native resume is shown only when the installed harness has a verified resume protocol. Current Grok and OpenCode history remain inspect/search/handoff-only. OpenClaw is not shipped.

## Key facts

- Author: Tardis
- License: MIT
- Price: $0
- Platform: Windows preview
- Version: 0.3.19
- Search: local SQLite FTS/BM25; optional localhost embeddings
- Handoff: reference-only; source transcripts stay read-only
- MCP: cannot mint approvals, add sources, or attach a PTY
- Distinct from: Microsoft Mobius, ControlTheory Möbius, Circular Labs Mobius
